summary: Agenus Inc. filed an 8-K reporting that its subsidiary Agenus West, LLC, with Agenus as guarantor, amended its existing promissory note with Ocean 1181 LLC. The loan's outstanding principal remains $24.75 million, maturity extended to November 30, 2029, and interest stays at 13.0% per annum. Monthly interest remains payable half cash, half stock; an extension fee of $247,500 is payable similarly. Shares issued under the note will be unregistered under Section 4(a)(2)/Reg D. This is a routine financing modification, not a special situation; no equity price, premium, or strategic action is involved.
